milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must navigate near the red tulips (centered at ~2, ~0, ~4) and face toward them, confirming visual observation. max_distance=10 allows detection from the path, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the tulips.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must navigate near the potted cornflower at ~0, ~1, ~7 and face toward it. max_distance=8 requires closer proximity than the tulips since the potted flower is smaller and harder to see.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must navigate near the jack o'lantern at ~5, ~1, ~11 and face toward it. max_distance=10 allows detection from the gravel path approach, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the glowing landmark.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must navigate near the orange wool blocks inside the building at ~9, ~1, ~13 and face toward them. max_distance=6 requires the player to be at or inside the building entrance to trigger, ensuring they've actually located the wool rather than just being nearby outside.
